svg.title: Travel time from one origin to a grid, walking and by public transport
svg.desc: Two maps of Porto Alegre covered by a grid of hexagons, coloured by the median travel time from Farroupilha Park: on the left walking, on the right walking plus public transport. Walking reaches the cells within about three kilometres in an hour; with public transport most of the grid is within an hour, and the cells along the bus corridors and the train line are reached in 30 to 45 minutes.
